description.value: Ferraro Foods is an independently owned, full-service supermarket that has anchored the Trail and Rossland communities since 1943, now employing over 150 people across its two Kootenay locations. The Trail store features a full-service Meat & Seafood Shoppe, Cheese Shoppe, Deli, in-house Bakery, and an in-store Starbucks kiosk. The store produces an impressive range of house-made items under its own brand, from over 25 sausage varieties to heat-and-serve meals, making it a well-stocked resupply point for cyclists passing through the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ferraro Foods is a real, actively operating independent supermarket with two BC locations (Trail and Rossland); the OSM coordinates (49.096°N, 117.710°W) place this record at the Trail location, consistent with the website's Trail address of 850 Farwell Street. The website provides full contact details for both stores but the OSM record contains no address or phone, so those fields are sourced from the website's Trail location listing. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or most cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; hot food is confirmed via the deli's explicit mention of soups, Grab-n-Go meals, and the in-store Starbucks kiosk at the Trail location.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone tags; address and phone sourced from website Trail location listing.
